body.name: Block-multinomial confidence polytope
body.construction: \(\mathcal C_N\) is the set of \(o',e'\) satisfying the probability-simplex and cell-compatibility restrictions together with \(|o'_{is}-\widehat o_{is}|\leq\varepsilon_0\) and \(|e'_{js}-\widehat e_{js}|\leq\varepsilon_j\) for all cells.
